title: Meet the Canopy Xi’an Qujiang Team Connecting the City’s Past and Present
summary: At Canopy Xi’an Qujiang, guests can feel at home in the world while discovering the people, stories, and traditions that make the city unique.

In one of China’s most historic cities, travelers discover a destination where centuries‑old traditions and contemporary culture exist side by side


- **Go behind the scenes with the latest installment of Hilton’s Behind the Stay series, spotlighting the remarkable team members whose passion, personality and local perspective make Hilton the World’s Best Place to Stay.**
- **Discover how the Canopy Xi’an Qujiang team enjoy helping guests embrace local traditions while finding fresh ways to contemporize historic art forms for a new generation.**
- **Meet the people who bring their own talents and interests to work each day, creating memorable experiences that connect guests to the people, stories and culture of Xi’an.**


In Xi’an, China, the past is never far away. With a history stretching back thousands of years, the city invites travelers to step into another era while simultaneously experiencing the vibrant energy of modern China. At[Canopy Xi’an Qujiang](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/xiypypy-canopy-xian-qujiang/) , guests can feel at home in the world while discovering the people, stories, and traditions that make the city unique. Here, Duty Manager Cheery describes visiting Xi’an as “embarking on a journey through time,” from the Tang Dynasty to the present day. For the team, helping guests experience that journey goes beyond pointing them toward the city’s landmarks. It’s about creating genuine connections to the people, stories, and experiences that shape Xi’an.


Throughout Canopy Xi’an Qujiang, team members work to connect travelers to the city through their own interests, experiences and personalities. For Chief Butler Lacey, that means drawing on her dance training. When five women arrived at the hotel dressed in elegant traditional attire, Lacey offered to take a group photo. Noticing they seemed a little unsure of how to pose, she stepped in with a few tips from her dance background, helping them feel at ease and creating a memory they could take home.


Senior Sales Manager Amber brings that same creative spirit to another side of Xi’an’s culture: music. One of her most memorable experiences involved collaborating with a DJ to blend electronic melodies and dance tracks with traditional Chinese opera – a bold combination which brought past and present together in an unexpected way. It reflected Canopy Xi’an Qujiang’s approach to connecting travelers with the city through its deep heritage and contemporary outlook. As Amber explains, “We are constantly striving to create new and innovative fusions,” with the hope that travelers will leave, wanting to return to Xi’an and explore even more.


Connections can also happen in quieter ways. Front Office Manager Daisy remembers a young Australian couple who found themselves at the hotel in heavy snowfall shortly after Chinese New Year. With the weather making sightseeing difficult, Daisy and the team talked with them about their interests and suggested other places to experience. The couple later returned to Xi’an with the intention of settling down for the long term. For Daisy, it was a sign that they had experienced enough of the city through the hotel and its people to imagine making Xi’an home. It’s the kind of connection Canopy seeks to create, welcoming travelers in a way that can make somewhere new feel little more like home.


Canopy Xi’an Qujiang


Team members at this hotel are warmly encouraged to bring their whole selves to their roles. Chef de Partie Star enjoys surprising guests through unique culinary experiences, while Duty Engineer Sam uses his passion for DIY videos to solve problems for guests and colleagues alike.


For General Manager Barbara, it's this individuality that gives Canopy Xi’an Qujiang its unique character. When team members are encouraged to be themselves, she says, their service becomes more personal and distinctive. “Just like the two sides of this city, we connect the new and the old through our team members,” said Barbara.


At Canopy Xi’an Qujiang, that connection turns a hotel stay into a heartfelt introduction to a city that proudly carries its history forward, shaped by the people who call it home. Just as Xi’an continues to evolve while staying connected to its roots, so too does Canopy. The brand is entering an exciting new chapter, with a new identity that brings its distinctive personality and approach to connecting guests with local culture to life. As this new identity is introduced across the brand, guests will discover new expressions of the Canopy experience in markets around the world.


##### FAQ: Meet the Canopy Xi’an Qujiang Team Connecting the City’s Past and Present


Canopy Xi’an Qujiang offers travelers an opportunity to experience Xi’an’s rich history and contemporary culture through a distinctly local lens. Located in one of China’s most historic cities, the hotel connects guests to the destination through thoughtful service, local traditions and the personal perspectives of team members who know and love Xi’an.


The Canopy Xi’an Qujiang team helps guests discover the people, traditions and experiences that make the city unique. From sharing recommendations for things to do in Xi’an to helping guests embrace local customs and finding creative ways to blend traditional art forms with modern culture, team members offer a personal introduction to both historic and contemporary Xi’an.


Team members bring their individual talents and interests into their roles to create personalized experiences for guests. Chief Butler Lacey draws on her dance background to help guests feel confident posing in traditional attire, while Senior Sales Manager Amber explores creative ways to combine contemporary music with traditional Chinese opera. Across the hotel, these personal touches help guests form meaningful connections with Xi’an and its culture.


Featured in Hilton’s Behind the Stay series, Canopy Xi’an Qujiang demonstrates how team members can bring a destination to life through their personalities, passions and local knowledge. By encouraging team members to bring their whole selves to work, the hotel creates distinctive experiences that connect guests with Xi’an’s past and present while supporting Hilton’s vision of being the World’s Best Place to Stay.
